data.color: black; mso-themecolor: text1;">Exude timeless elegance with this exquisite unstitched ensemble. The striking black and white print forms a classic canvas, beautifully complemented by intricate rust-colored embroidery that graces the neckline and sleeves. The embroidery, inspired by vintage artistry, adds a rich depth and sophistication to the outfit
